result_text:
I fixed the four default conventions so they match the files they were meant for. The new test and the existing `SourceFileFilterTest` pass (8 tests, offline Maven).

- **`GeneratedConventions.java`**
  - The pkgdown, Doxygen and meta-generator rules now use `.*[.](htm|html|xhtml)` instead of `.*[.](html|html|xhtml)`. This also removes the duplicate `html`.
  - The JavaScript rule is now `.*[.]js` instead of `.*/[.]js`.
  - The .NET doc rule is now `.*[.]xml` instead of `.*/[.]xml`.
- **`BuildAndDeploymentConventions.java`**: the Gradle script rule is now `.*[-]gradle[.]js` instead of `.*[.][-]gradle[.]js`.
- **New `codeanalyzer/src/test/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/DefaultConventionsTest.java`**: checks that the affected files now match (`.htm` pkgdown/Doxygen/meta pages, `.html` Doxygen, `.xhtml` meta, `MyAssembly.xml` with `<doc>`, `app.js` with `// Generated by`, `build-gradle.js`, `build.gradle`). It also checks that hand-written `.htm`, `.js` and `.xml` files stay out.

The path patterns are full-path regexes, so the `/` and `[.]` in front of the extension made the old rules unmatchable. Nothing is committed.
